name: Mars ★ Ball
source:
Humans migrate to Mars, where the description of ancient sport is found in the ruins and it becomes the new craze - the Marsball.
An ordinary salaryman gets fired and with his baseball experience in high school he tries his luck as a manager of a new Marsball team.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-february-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
人类移居火星，在废墟中发现了对古代运动的描述，并成为新的热潮——火星球。
一名普通工薪族被解雇了，凭借高中棒球经验，他尝试担任一支新马斯球队的经理。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-february-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
